So the FY2024 restatement appears to reverse the FY2023 overstatement. That suggests the printed lines (630,452) are right and the 689,434 total and 488,464 statement line overstate spending. No restatement amount is printed on the FY2024 trimmed page; only the 'restated' label. The figures stay as printed and decision_needed[0] covers it. The question should mention the FY2024 restatement.
